jobs.title: Client Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
Our Company:

PharMerica

Overview:

\*\* This is a remote role\*\*

The Implementation Consultant is responsible for independently leading and managing new customer implementations, change of ownership initiatives, pharmacy and facility moves, and other complex customer transition projects. This role serves as a consultative partner to customers and internal stakeholders, assessing business and operational needs, developing implementation strategies, identifying risks, recommending solutions, and guiding projects through successful completion.

The Implementation Consultant exercises discretion and independent judgment in evaluating customer requirements, interpreting operational needs, establishing project priorities, resolving complex implementation issues, and recommending appropriate courses of action. The position works collaboratively across multiple functional areas to ensure implementation solutions align with customer expectations, operational capabilities, service standards, and business objectives.

The successful candidate is highly organized, forward-thinking, analytical, and an effective communicator who takes a proactive and consultative approach to problem solving. This individual must be comfortable independently leading multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while adapting strategies based on changing customer and operational needs.

**Benefits and perks for You!**

* Medical, Dental, Vision insurance
* Health Savings & Flexible Spending Accounts (up to $5,000 for childcare)
* Tuition discounts & reimbursement
* 401(k)
* Company Paid Time Off\*
* Shift Differential
* DailyPay
* Pet Insurance
* Employee wellness and discount programs

* *Benefits may vary by employment status*

Responsibilities:

* Serves as the primary implementation consultant and subject matter resource for assigned new customer implementations, change of ownership projects, pharmacy moves, facility relocations, and other customer transition initiatives
* Independently leads assigned implementation projects from initial planning through execution, stabilization, and post-implementation review
* Consults with customers and internal stakeholders to assess business needs, operational requirements, service expectations, implementation readiness, and potential risks
* Exercises discretion and independent judgment to evaluate project requirements and determine appropriate implementation strategies, priorities, timelines, and recommended courses of action
* Develops comprehensive implementation plans, project timelines, milestones, agendas, and deliverables based on customer requirements and organizational objectives
* Evaluates customer needs and recommend appropriate products, services, processes, or operational solutions to support a successful transition
* Provides consultative guidance to customers regarding implementation requirements, operational considerations, dependencies, timelines, and recommended practices
* Determines the appropriate involvement of internal service areas, including Customer Field Service, IV, Clinical Consulting, Clinical HUB, pharmacy operations, and other functional partners based on the individual needs of each implementation
* Leads internal and external project meetings, facilitate discussions, provide recommendations, communicate decisions, assign action items, and ensure appropriate follow-up
* Analyzes complex or changing project circumstances and independently identify solutions or recommendations based on available information, customer requirements, business needs, and operational considerations
* Proactively identifies project risks, implementation barriers, service gaps, and competing priorities and develop mitigation strategies to minimize disruption to customers and operations
* Uses advanced knowledge of pharmacy operations, service standards, and implementation practices to anticipate challenges and determine appropriate solutions
* Provides guidance and recommendations to internal stakeholders regarding customer requirements and the operational impact of implementation decisions
* Investigates implementation and quality concerns, determine root causes, recommend corrective actions, and escalate significant business or customer issues when appropriate
* Evaluates changes in project scope, business requirements, timelines, or operational circumstances and determine necessary modifications to implementation plans
* Conducts pre-implementation assessments to evaluate customer and operational readiness and identify opportunities requiring additional planning or intervention
* Conducts post-implementation assessments to evaluate results, identify trends or service gaps, and recommend actions to improve customer outcomes and future implementations
* Analyzes customer feedback, implementation outcomes, operational experience, and project data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement
* Recommends improvements to implementation processes, workflows, tools, documentation, and customer transition practices
* Develops and communicates implementation metrics, project status, risks, outcomes, and recommendations to customers, business partners, and leadership
* Creates and maintains customer-specific implementation documentation in accordance with department and organizational standards
* Ensures project documentation, decisions, action items, deliverables, and customer requirements are accurately maintained within designated systems and SharePoint
* Independently manages multiple concurrent implementation projects and establish priorities based on customer impact, operational risk, project complexity, timelines, and organizational objectives
* Builds collaborative relationships with customers and cross-functional business partners and influence outcomes without direct supervisory authority
* Serves as a resource to internal partners regarding implementation processes, customer transition requirements, and recommended practices
* Participates in special projects and initiatives intended to improve customer implementation processes and overall service delivery
* Performs other related duties as assigned
* Conducts job responsibilities in accordance with the Company's Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, policies and procedures, Corporate Compliance Agreement, applicable federal and state laws, and applicable professional standards

Qualifications:

* Minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible experience in customer implementation, project management, project coordination, healthcare operations, pharmacy operations, customer relationship management, or a related field required
* Experience independently managing customer implementations, projects, operational initiatives, or complex cross-functional activities required
* Demonstrated experience assessing business or operational needs and recommending solutions required
* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, independently evaluate information, identify risks, and determine appropriate courses of action required
* Experience managing multiple projects or priorities with competing deadlines required
* Experience within pharmacy, healthcare, or customer implementation operations preferred
* Experience in a Long-Term Care Pharmacy environment preferred
* Experience consulting with customers regarding operational processes, services, or business solutions desired
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional customer implementations desired
* High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required
* Combination of education, training, and progressively responsible professional experience sufficient to successfully perform the responsibilities of the position required
* Associate's or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Project Management, Pharmacy/Healthcare Services, or a related discipline preferred
* Project management certification or formal project management training preferred
* Pharmacy Technician certification or registration, where applicable desired
* Strong consultative and customer relationship management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment
* Ability to assess customer business and operational needs and recommend appropriate solutions
* Strong project leadership and project management skills
* Ability to independently analyze complex situations and determine appropriate courses of action
* Strong critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to anticipate project risks and develop effective mitigation strategies
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong presentation, consultation, and meeting facilitation capabilities
* Ability to communicate recommendations effectively to customers, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders
* Ability to influence decisions and outcomes without direct authority
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills
* Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational abilities
* Ability to independently manage multiple complex projects with competing priorities and deadlines
* Ability to adapt strategies and recommendations based on changing customer and business requirements
* Strong attention to detail while maintaining a broader understanding of customer and organizational objectives
* Ability to interpret project metrics and use information to identify trends and opportunities for improvement
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant project management and collaboration technology
* Experience using metrics and performance indicators to evaluate project outcomes
* Working knowledge of pharmacy operations, standards, and customer service requirements, as applicable
* Ability to work effectively and independently within a remote work environment

  
About our Line of Business: PharMerica, an affiliate of BrightSpring Health Services, delivers personalized pharmacy care through dedicated local teams, serving health care providers such as skilled nursing facilities, senior living communities, and hospitals. We also cater to individuals with behavioral needs, infusion therapy needs, seniors receiving in-home care, and patients with cancer. Operating long-term care, home infusion, and specialty pharmacies across the nation, we combine the personal touch of a neighborhood pharmacy with the resources of a national network. Our comprehensive solutions, backed by industry-leading technology and regulatory expertise, ensure accurate medication access, cost control, and compliance with best-in-class clinical standards. We are committed to enhancing resident health, reducing staff burdens, and supporting our clients' success. For more information, visit www.pharmerica.com. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Sr. Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Why TrueAccord?**

TrueAccord, a wholly owned subsidiary of TrueML, is a category-defining company. We combine machine learning with a human-based approach to transform debt resolution and to get people on the path towards financial health. Every year, more than 70 million Americans have negative experiences dealing with debt. We are changing this by providing personalized digital experiences that guide lenders and consumers through this challenging financial process.

With a world-class leadership team, passionate team members, and proprietary predictive models trained on years worth of transactional data, TrueAccord is well-positioned to deliver on a huge opportunity: helping millions of consumers to regain and keep their financial footing while lowering the cost of doing business for creditors across many industries.

### **About This Role:**

Join our Implementation team as a Sr. Implementation Specialist, a high-impact, execution-focused role built for a driven coordinator looking to launch a career in Technical Project Management. You will play a dual role: independently leading end-to-end onboarding for our smaller, standardized clients while providing essential organizational support for our largest Enterprise launches. Your ultimate goal is to ensure seamless, accurate client launches and keep complex implementation workflows moving smoothly on schedule.

### **What You'll Do:**

* **Lead Growth Client Launches**: Independently manage the end-to-end onboarding for small-scale "Growth CSV" clients, executing fast, accurate, and repeatable short-term workflows.
* **Support Enterprise Implementations**: Partner closely with Senior Implementation Managers as their primary support lead, handling the organizational and logistical heavy lifting for complex, large-scale client launches.
* **Own Documentation & Governance:** Serve as the team's lead Document Manager by creating and maintaining RAIDS logs, project folders, and central document repositories.
* **Drive Project Momentum & Visibility:** Own daily and weekly task lists, escalate potential timeline risks early, orchestrate meetings with clear agendas, and distribute weekly status updates and action items.
* **Facilitate Cross-Functional Alignment:** Coordinate syncs and track deliverables across internal teams with sharp attention to detail, enabling senior leaders to stay focused on high-level strategy.

### **Who You Are:**

* **Aspiring Technical Project Manager:** Early-to-mid-career coordinator with foundational analytical skills who thrives in structured, repeatable workflows and is eager to grow into complex project management.
* **Detail-Oriented & Tactical:** Highly organized and reliable when executing clearly defined project tasks on tight timelines (days to weeks).
* **Strong Communicator & Collaborator:** Comfortable leading meetings, writing clear status updates, and aligning stakeholders across internal teams.
* **Coachable & Process-Minded:** Works well within established processes and proactively seeks guidance when encountering complex edge cases outside of standard playbooks.
* **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. (No formal certifications like a PMP or regulatory background required; exposure to technical environments is a bonus!)

For U.S.-based hires, the overall base salary framework for this role currently spans **$80,000 to $90,000** per year. The applicable base salary range for any individual hire depends on the geographic labor market associated with the employee’s primary work location along with other factors such as relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.  
  
Geographic labor markets are divided into "tiers" based upon a number of factors, including cost of living. Below, you'll find a few example cities representative of each tiers:

* **U.S. Geo Tier 1** (i.e. San Francisco, New York City, Boston)
* **U.S. Geo Tier 2** (i.e.Austin, Denver, Phoenix)
* **U.S. Geo Tier 3** (i.e.Kansas City, Jacksonville, Indianapolis)

We encourage you to speak to your recruiter to learn more about our compensation philosophy as well as discuss our benefits, total rewards, and opportunities for growth.

### **What We Offer (Perks & Benefits)**

* Flexible vacation
* Medical/dental/vision insurance
* Traditional/Roth retirement savings options
* Company-paid disability and life insurance
* Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA
* Family-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off
* On-demand wellness platform access for you and 5 friends and family
* PerkSpot discount program for 900+ merchants nationwide
  

### **Recruiting Fraud Notice:**

We’re aware of fraudulent recruiters posing as TrueAccord or TrueML and contacting job seekers. To protect yourself, here’s how our real hiring process works:

* **Official channels only.** Our recruiters email only from @trueaccord.com [If you’ve received an InMail, you should verify the recruiter’s @trueaccord.com email]

* **No payments or financial info during hiring.** We will never ask you to pay fees, buy equipment, or share banking information during the hiring process.

* **No text or chat-app interviews.** We do not conduct interviews by text message or messaging apps.

* **No “portals” or access keys.** We do not send PDF portals or access keys, or ask for passwords or login credentials.

* **No resume services.** We will never require an “ATS-friendly” resume rewrite or recommend paid resume services.

If someone contacting you on our behalf does any of the above, it is fraud.

**Stay safe:**

* Don’t open attachments, click links, or share personal information.
* Report the message as phishing to your email provider, and report fake profiles to LinkedIn.
* Not sure? Verify by emailing recruiting@trueaccord.com before responding.

**If you’ve already shared information with suspected scammers:** Contact your bank, visit identitytheft.gov, and report the fraud at reportfraud.ftc.gov or ic3.gov.

### **Remote Work, Travel Expectations, & Physical Requirements**

This role supports a global, cross-functional business and operates primarily in a Remote-First environment. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects.

This position primarily involves computer-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required.

  

### **Personally Identifying Information**

We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy.

  

### **Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion**

We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: EMR System Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview:

Our mission is Better Health. Our passion is helping others.

**What's Your Why?**

* Are you looking for a career opportunity that will help you grow personally and professionally?
* Do you have a passion for helping others achieve Better Health?
* Are you ready to join a growing team that shares your mission?

**Why Join Our Team:** At Better Health Group, it's our commitment, our passion, and our culture that sets us apart. Our Team Members make a difference each and every day! They support our providers and payors, ensuring they have the necessary tools and resources to always deliver best-in-class healthcare experiences for our patients. We don't just talk the talk - we believe in it and live by it. Be part of a team that shares your passion and drive, and start living your purpose at Better Health Group.

Responsibilities:

**Reports To:** Senior Manager EMR Optimization and Strategy

**Position Objective:**

The EMR System Analyst supports the configuration, maintenance, optimization, and day-to-day administration of the organization’s Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system, eClinicalWorks (eCW). Serving as an eClinicalWorks subject matter expert, this role supports administrative, financial, clinical, quality, and operational efficiencies through the EMR and its integrated systems. The EMR System Analyst partners with leadership, providers, and clinic staff to resolve system issues, improve workflows, support quality and value-based care programs, and help ensure the EMR is used effectively and in compliance with healthcare regulations.

**Responsibilities:**

**EMR System Administration**

* Serves as an EMR subject matter expert (SME) and go-to resource for providers, clinic staff, and leadership on system functionality and best practices
* Performs EMR system administration, including user setup, role-based security, configurations, templates, settings, and routine system maintenance
* Configures the EMR to meet the clinical, administrative, and operational needs of providers and clinic staff
* Sets up new clinic sites in the EMR (new facilities, programs, providers, users, interfaces, etc.)
* Coordinates and performs comprehensive testing of all patches, upgrades, and new releases
* Attends ongoing EMR training to stay current on features and upcoming enhancements

**EMR Support, Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution**

* Provides timely, high-quality support to EMR users, including physicians, APPs, and administrative staff
* Identifies, troubleshoots, and resolves system issues and user errors efficiently, escalating complex issues as appropriate
* Submits, monitors, and follows up on support tickets with EMR system and serves as a primary point of contact for issues and requests related to the EMR and clinic peripheral systems
* Monitors system performance and recommends improvements to enhance user experience and system efficiency
* Reports any unusual events or problems with applications and/or program operations to supervisor

**Workflow & Documentation Development**

* Analyzes clinical and administrative workflows and processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement
* Develops and maintains workflow documentation, user guides, tip sheets, training materials, and standard operating procedures
* Delivers training to new and existing EMR users

**Business Process Improvement & EMR Optimization**

* Identifies EMR system, process, performance, and architectural improvements to support the technical roadmap and business needs across Administrative, Clinical, Quality, Financial, and Operational areas
* Recommends and implements solutions and best practices to optimize EMR-driven workflows and improve EMR utilization
* Configures and maintains the EMR Clinical Rules Engine (alerts, reminders, and clinical decision support rules) to support clinical best practices, care gap closure, and quality measure performance

**Data Migration, EMR Implementation & Go-Live Support**

* Supports EMR implementations, new module and application rollouts, and modifications to existing applications
* Assists with data migration activities, including data mapping, validation, and reconciliation during system conversions and new clinic onboarding
* Provides go-live and at-the-elbow support to clinics and staff during implementations and major system changes
* Supports data backup and recovery processes in coordination with IT and EMR vendors

**Quality Measures & Value-Based Care**

* Supports quality and value-based care program
* Builds, maintains, and monitors the EMR dashboards to track provider and organizational performance on quality measures
* Performs and maintains EMR Community mapping to ensure structured data is accurately captured and credited for quality measure reporting
* Maintains clinical program data collection, management, and reporting infrastructure for UDS, HEDIS, OSHPD, and other external agencies
* Works with others to create formal specifications for internal and external reporting and ensures all reporting is properly specified, documented, tested, implemented, and maintained

**Reporting & Advanced Analytics**

* Authors custom reports using EMR reporting tools to meet clinical, operational, and financial reporting needs
* Builds robust dashboards that monitor clinical quality, medical cost, quality statistics, key trends, program tracking, and operational performance
* Applies advanced analytics to identify trends and support analytical, data-driven decision making
* Generates reports and presents findings to providers, administrators, and other stakeholders in a clear, concise format tailored to the audience
* Supports data extraction and helps ensure the integrity, accuracy, and security of patient data within the EMR

**EMR Billing Workflow & Configuration**

* Supports EMR billing workflows and configuration, including claims routing, in partnership with Revenue Cycle teams
* Supports, analyzes, and monitors EMR processes for clinical and billing functions across all clinics

**Interfaces & EMR Integrations**

* Supports EMR interfaces and integrations with lab companies (e.g., Quest, Labcorp), immunization registries, and HIE / QHIN networks
* Collaborates with vendors and external organizations to set up, test, troubleshoot, and maintain interfaces
* Coordinates with the IT department on any projects that affect network operations

**AI & Emerging Technology**

* Supports the configuration, rollout, and user adoption AI technologies within EMR

**Project Management**

* Plans and coordinates assigned EMR projects, including tasks, timelines, and stakeholder communication, to support timely and successful completion
* Serves as a liaison among clinical staff, IT, and EMR vendors

**Compliance & General**

* Supports EMR compliance with federal, state, and local healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, and adheres to all State and Federal guidelines and standards
* Participates in security audits and risk assessments as requested
* Participates in Management, Staff, and Quality meetings as requested
* Travels to clinics as needed
* Additional duties as assigned

**Position Requirements/ Skills:**

* High School diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 5+ years of experience working with EMR systems
* Experience in healthcare, specifically with EMR/EHR system administration and support
* eClinicalWorks (eCW) experience required; Athena experience preferred
* Experience with quality measures and value-based care programs (HEDIS, ACO, UDS, MIPS), including the MIPS Dashboard and eCW Community mapping
* Experience with the eCW Clinical Rules Engine, preferred
* Experience with eCW eBO report authoring and custom reports, preferred
* Experience with EMR interfaces and integrations (lab companies, HIE / QHIN)
* Experience supporting data migration, EMR implementations, and go-live activities
* Knowledge of eCW billing workflows, configuration, and claims routing
* Familiarity with Sunoh.AI or other ambient AI documentation tools, preferred
* Knowledge of clinical workflows and healthcare operations
* Experience with data analysis and healthcare reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, and/or statistical packages), preferred
* Project management experience; familiarity with business process improvement and change management preferred
* Relevant healthcare IT or informatics certifications are a plus
* Knowledge of role-based security and HIPAA rules and regulations
* Proficient with Google Suite (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides) for real-time collaboration
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills; comfortable engaging with internal and external stakeholders, including providers and health plans
* Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively across cross-functional teams with minimal supervision
* Exceptional organizational, time-management, and attention-to-detail skills; capable of balancing multiple priorities effectively
* Demonstrated ability to handle sensitive data with confidentiality and maintain professionalism
* Results-oriented mindset with a focus on quality execution and delivery
* Strong presentation skills
* Appreciation of cultural diversity and sensitivity toward target patient populations

**Physical Requirements:**

* Physical ability to sit, stand, walk, and move freely for extended periods, including climbing stairs as needed.
* Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, squat, twist, reach, and pull as required for tasks.
* Frequent use of office equipment, including computers, printers, and copy machines.
* Availability to travel to clinical sites or vendor locations and to provide on-call support when necessary.

**Key Attributes/ Skills:**

* Has a contagious and positive work ethic, inspires others, and models the behaviors of core values and guiding principles
* An effective team player who contributes valuable ideas and feedback and can be counted on to meet commitments
* Is able to work within our Better Health environment by facing tasks and challenges with energy and passion
* Pursues activities with focus and drive, defines work in terms of success, and can be counted on to complete goals

jobs.title: Associate Implementation Specialist - Remote
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Associate Implementation Specialist is responsible for assisting a Karmak customer to seamlessly and productively implement the Karmak business system from first engagement to after the Bring Live. This includes configuring Karmak's software based on the customer's needs, to help the customers implement strategic business processes, to convert the customer's data for setup, sandbox and live and by providing comprehensive training that gives our customers and their businesses the tools and knowledge to utilize the Karmak software effectively and efficiently. The Associate Implementation Specialist must be able to set up and train on one specific major module, as well as to be able to convert data for setup, sandbox and Bring Live. The Associate Implementation Specialist also must be able to complete Branch Adds, Module Adds and Merger/Acquisition setup and training for their specific module.

Essential Job Functions

* Guide and assist customers through the transition from their previous business system to Fusion by providing the following:
  + Enterprise and Business Strategy/Data Discussion calls. Includes explanation of data load-sheet requirements
  + Converting setup, sandbox and live data and communicating necessary changes and feedback to the customer
  + Configuring the new Karmak business system with input from the customer
  + Webinar training prior to Bring Live
  + Documenting and communicating notes at every step for all necessary parties' visibility and understanding. Including, but not limited to:
    - Business strategy Emails/Notes
    - Setup Checklists: internal and customer facing
    - Training Module Master Workbooks
    - Session Recordings
    - Recap emails
    - Clockify
    - GuideCX
    - Salesforce
    - Karmak-licensed AI tools
* Complete configuration and training portions of Branch Adds, Module Adds and/or Merger/Acquisitions based on the customer request. This includes:
  + Completing the assigned item(s) by the date provided by the customer and/or the Karmak Operations Coordinator
  + Notifying the Resource Coordinator or Operations Coordinator of any time or additional meetings which need to be scheduled
  + Maintaining communication with the customer and internal teams regarding needs and status of the assigned
  + Completing all documentation, cases and follow up items related to the assigned as process documents
  + Seeking out necessary resources to discuss any business-process related issues/items which may present themselves during the process
  + Conducting webinar training and/or remote/onsite training based on assigned services
* Conduct additional services webinars for existing customer base
* Understand Karmak's implementation process and the departments that impact that process
* Able to work with each of the necessary departments in a positive and accountable manner
* Understand Karmak's Branch Add, Module Add and Merger/Acquisition processes and the departments involved in those services. Able to work with each of the departments positively and professionally
* Be able to understand Salesforce and how it relates to Implementation Services projects. Able to find customer information and to read and understand all applicable documentation (Sales orders, cases, etc.). Able to professionally complete assigned cases and to close those cases within set timeframe.
* Have a basic understanding of business processes and their impact on the setup of the Karmak business system software
* Adherence to all Department and Team policies and processes as identified in written SOP documents

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

* Valid US Driver's License
* Ability to travel inside and outside of the United States
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products - Outlook, Word, Excel
* Basic understanding of Karmak-licensed AI tools and comfortability in their usage
* Ability to learn at least one major module of Karmak software
* Ability to complete data load-sheet conversations and to complete data conversions
* Ability to learn and work both independently and within the framework of a team
* Basic understanding of the business and industry of our customers
* Basic knowledge of various learning styles and how to apply them
* Customer service skills. Ability to maintain a professional attitude
* Ability to maintain focus and be detail oriented
* Have excellent time management and organizational skills
* Be able to work well within the framework of a team and to follow documented processes and procedures
* Possess exceptional communication skills
* Ability to accept and build on constructive criticism, both from team members and from customers
* Assume ownership and accept responsibility for all actions

*The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties. Additional responsibilities may be assigned.*

jobs.title: Manager - Production Support & Implementation
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

RRD is a leading global provider of marketing, packaging, print, and supply chain solutions that elevate engagement across the complete customer journey. The company offers the industry’s most trusted portfolio of creative execution and world-wide business process consulting, with services designed to lower environmental impact. With 22,000 clients, including 93% of the Fortune 100, and 32,000 employees across 28 countries, RRD brings the expertise, execution, and scale designed to transform customer touchpoints into meaningful moments of impact.

 **Job Description**

The Manager- Production Support & Implementation leads a team of Business Analysts while directly supporting new client onboarding and implementations. Operating at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution, this role drives requirements gathering, solution delivery, and stakeholder alignment. The Manager is responsible for team performance, resource management, and establishing standard business analysis methodologies across all client engagements.

Responsibilities:

• Manages, mentors, and allocates resources for a team of Business Analysts; drives team development, sets performance standards, and balances workloads across projects. • Leads end-to-end requirements gathering for new client onboardings, serving as the bridge between external clients, business stakeholders, and technical delivery teams. • Facilitates discovery sessions to define functional requirements, establish clear scope boundaries, and proactively identify and mitigate implementation risks. • Establishes standardized business analysis documentation frameworks, oversees User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and ensures high-quality delivery across all client projects. • Partners with cross-functional leadership to continuously refine onboarding workflows, improve operational efficiency, and elevate service quality.

 **Qualifications**

6 years relevant experience in business analysis, client implementations, or consulting.3 years experience in a formal or informal leadership capacity (e.g., team lead, manager, or senior mentor).Skills and Certifications • Strong expertise in requirements gathering, process mapping, UAT, and client relationship management. • Leadership and coaching abilities to manage, mentor, and allocate resources across multiple projects. • Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to evaluate complex workflows and mitigate implementation risks. • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging technical and non-technical teams. • Ability to establish standardized business analysis methodologies and quality assurance standards.

 **Additional Information**

RRD's current salary range for this role is $100,000 to $171,200 / year. The salary range may be adjusted  
based on the applicable geographic location of the hired employee, and the range may change in the  
future. At RRD, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and  
compensation decisions may vary based upon, but not limited to education, skills, experience, proficiency,  
performance, shift and location. Depending on the role, in addition to base salary, the total compensation  
package may also include participation in a bonus, commission or incentive program. RRD’s benefit  
offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, disability insurance, 401(k) with  
company match, life insurance and other voluntary supplemental insurance coverages, plus parental  
leave, adoption assistance, tuition assistance and employer/partner discounts.

RRD is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans

At RRD, we value innovation, authenticity, and integrity. To uphold the security and fairness of our hiring process, we ask that candidates refrain from using AI tools during interviews to ensure an authentic and secure experience. We appreciate your cooperation as we work to maintain a transparent and equitable hiring process.

All employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of both a pre-employment background and drug screen.

jobs.title: Project Manager IV- Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
**Employment for this position is contingent upon approval of contract funding.**

**Position Overview**

The ERP Project Manager leads cross-functional and cross-organizational teams in the planning, execution, and delivery of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) initiatives, including software implementations, upgrades, and modernization efforts. Working with minimal management oversight, this role provides project management leadership throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring solutions meet business objectives, technical requirements, and organizational standards

  

**Major Activities (Typical Duties/Responsibilities)**

The IT Project Manager is responsible for supporting strategic initiatives at the Hanford site, including defining tasks and timelines, coordinating across departments, managing budgets, and ensuring timely delivery. The IT Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, and completion of projects, ensuring consistency with organizational strategy, contractual commitments, and goals.

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

**Vendor and Implementor Oversight**

* Monitor external implementors for compliance with contractual scope, deliverables, schedules, implementation methodologies, and statements of work.
* Validate completion of project plans, RAID logs, cutover planning, requirements tracking, testing support, training, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Oversee discovery, design, configuration, testing, and knowledge-transfer activities.
* Verify deliverables align with approved scope, methodology, contractual commitments, and organizational standards.
* Identify and escalate vendor performance issues, delivery concerns, scope discrepancies, and contractual risks to program, product, contracting, and other appropriate leadership.
* Enforce vendor accountability without changing contract scope or formally approving deliverables.

**Internal Team and Resource Coordination**

jobs.title: Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
**What is Loancrate?**
----------------------

We started Loancrate to make home-buying simpler and less expensive for lenders and borrowers. Today, mortgage lenders are stuck running their companies on software products built 20 years ago. These products are slow, unstable, and don't lead to material improvements in efficiency. When using these systems, the average human cost to originate a loan is still over $11,000.

Loancrate builds AI-native tooling to automate mortgage workflows. Our ultimate goal is fully automated origination, which has the potential to save lenders over $16B in operating expense per year.

Since starting in 2020, our remote team has enabled our customers to power >$85 billion in new home loans. We care about collaboration, very open communication covering the good & the bad so that we learn from our decisions quickly, and ultimately having fun while we're building. You'll fit in well if you like diving deep quickly!

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Buying a new loan origination system is the easy part. Actually configuring it to match how a lender runs its business - their conditions, their disclosures, their underwriting guidelines, their quirks - is where implementations are won or lost. We're looking for an Implementation Consultant to be the person in the room (virtually or on-site) who makes that configuration work actually happen.

This is a forward-deployed, hands-on role. You'll work directly with a lender's team during the implementation phase to configure Loancrate around their workflows, answer their configuration questions, and get them through user acceptance testing. Once the customer is live, you roll off and move to the next implementation - the CSM stays on as the long-term relationship owner, and the Implementation Lead keeps the overall project plan on track, while you're the one actually in the product with the customer making it work.

Because this role sits inside an active mortgage workflow from day one, you need to already be fluent in mortgage - not learning it as you go. We can teach you Loancrate inside and out. What we can't do in any reasonable timeframe is teach you what a lender's processors and underwriters actually need a system to do for them.

This is a foundational role on a team we're building from scratch: you'll help define what "good configuration" looks like, build the muscle memory for how we implement lenders quickly and correctly, and be one of the people whose work most directly determines whether a customer's go-live goes smoothly.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Act as the forward-deployed implementation expert - work directly with the customer's team to configure Loancrate around their specific workflows, conditions, and business rules.
* Translate a lender's current-system setup into a Loancrate configuration - take how they operate today and recommend (and build) the configuration that gets them the same outcome, or better, in Loancrate.
* Own testing support during UAT - respond to configuration and testing questions as they come in, and work the "UAT Blocked" queue in Jira so customer-reported blockers get resolved quickly instead of sitting.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues in real time - when something isn't behaving the way the customer expects, you're the one who can dig in, find the root cause, and fix it or escalate it clearly.
* Work closely with the Implementation Lead and CSM - you're heads-down on configuration and testing; they're managing the timeline and the broader relationship, and you keep them informed of anything that could affect either.
* Roll off cleanly at go-live - document the final configuration and any open items clearly enough that the CSM can pick up the relationship without a gap.
* Help build the implementation playbook - common configuration patterns, frequently asked setup questions, and testing checklists that make the next implementation faster than the last.
* Willingness to travel - expect approximately once-a-month domestic US travel to customer sites, with occasional additional trips around key milestones like UAT kickoff and go-live.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Within your first 90 days, you will:

* Be the hands-on configuration owner on at least one active implementation, trusted by the customer to answer setup questions directly.
* Have cleared UAT-Blocked tickets at a pace that keeps testing moving rather than stalling on your queue.
* Have handled a real configuration curveball - a workflow that doesn't map cleanly to Loancrate - and worked it to a resolution the customer was happy with.
* Have a direct working relationship with your Implementation Lead and CSM, with a clear handoff process for when you roll off a project.

By the 12-18 month mark, you'll have implemented multiple lenders end-to-end, be a go-to resource for tricky configuration scenarios, and be a candidate to help train and ramp future Implementation Consultants as the team grows.

**Required Skills and Background**
----------------------------------

* **Direct mortgage experience** - you've worked at a lender or mortgage tech company and understand the origination-to-closing lifecycle (1003, LE, CD, AUS findings, conditions, lock extensions) well enough to configure a system around it without hand-holding.
* **Hands-on experience with a loan origination system** (Encompass, Empower, Byte, or similar) - you've worked inside one, ideally helped configure or administer one, and know where lenders' real-world workflows get tricky.
* **Comfort working hands-on in software configuration** - you're not afraid to get into settings, rules, and workflows yourself rather than just describing what needs to change to someone else.
* **Testing and troubleshooting instincts** - you can read a bug report or a UAT ticket, reproduce the issue, and tell the difference between a configuration fix, a training gap, and an actual product bug.
* **Clear, patient communication** - you'll be answering the same category of question from different customers constantly, and need to do it clearly and without making anyone feel behind.
* **Comfort with a project-phase role** - you're energized by the intensity of an implementation and the clean handoff at the end, rather than wanting to own the long-term relationship.
* **Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity** - we're building this function from the ground up; you'll be figuring out the right way to configure something as often as you're executing a known pattern.
* **Curiosity about AI and how it's changing mortgage workflows** - you don't need an ML background, but you should be excited to help configure and explain AI-driven features to customers.
* **Proactive, independent workstyle** - you keep plans, trackers, agendas, and follow-ups moving without needing someone to remind you; when a decision is needed, you bring the relevant context and options to the right person.

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

* Robust medical coverage (100% of employee + family premiums covered)
* Vision & dental coverage
* 401(k)
* HSA / FSA
* Access to lender partner’s employee loan program
* Remote-first culture - work from wherever you do your best work
* Flexible time off - we trust you to manage your time

*Loancrate is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

Compensation Range: $130K - $180K

jobs.description:
**About the Role**
==================

We are looking for a hands-on, technically minded Product Operations & Implementation Manager to help drive the successful adoption, operation, and continued improvement of our technology platform. You will become a subject matter expert on our product, serve as the connective link between clients, sales, product, and tech, and help translate what customers need into workable solutions.

This role's top priority will be ensuring client pre-sale scoping is executed, verifying our implementation and product readiness, and executing the client setup, configuration, training, onboarding, and implementation end-to-end successfully. Just as important, the foundation and standard procedures for our implementations are still to be defined, and must be setup for scale and efficiency by this role.

This is a highly hybrid role that brings together project management, client and account management, product operations, and technical implementation. The ideal candidate has experience across several of these areas and enjoys moving between client-facing responsibilities, coordinating projects, understanding technical requirements, and improving products and processes for scale.

**Work Arrangements**
=====================

Type: Full time, remote position. To be considered candidates must be located in one of the following states within the USA: CA, CO, CT, IL, MI, TN, VA, OH, FL. Candidates located elsewhere will not be considered and should not apply.

Candidates interested in part time or contractor opportunities may also be considered.

Working hours: Flexibility to work with both EMEA and California based colleagues is essential for success in this role. The right candidate will be ambitious, fast paced, self motivated, and capable of managing their own schedule with flexibility as needed to get the job done.

**What You'll Do**

**Client implementation and project coordination**

* Coordinate and execute end-to-end client implementations, from initial scoping and solution design, to readiness check and verification, testing, client setup, rollout and handoff to ongoing support.
* Work with Sales, Product and Technology to scope customized solutions and turn requirements into actionable technical plans.
* Own client-specific platform configuration, including metadata imports, integrations, APIs, taxonomy, and folder structures.
* Conduct product testing and verification against client expectations and pre-sales scoping, ensuring that client expectations and what is being sold is realistic, and achievable.
* Maintain project plans, track dependencies, and escalate risks or delays early. See to it that client projects and implementations assigned are completed successfully, smoothly, and timely.
* Standardize the proper procedure for client offboardings, and execute any client offboardings as needed.
* Develop repeatable implementation processes and templates that allow us to onboard new clients efficiently and consistently.

**Platform operations, knowledge, and performance**

* Develop a deep understanding of our platform, its capabilities, configurations, and technical workflows, positioning yourself as the product expert within the delivery and operations team, reducing the need to bring developers or product managers into client facing meetings.
* Build stronger product knowledge and skills within the delivery and operations team, cross training and upskilling colleagues to be just as capable at client onboarding and demonstrations as you.
* With the Technology team, build dashboards and reporting on usage, service performance, trends and account overages.
* Analyze costs, licensing and utilization, and fix recurring issues to improve efficiency and scalability.
* Participate in light prototyping as needed to better illustrate client feedback on product needs.
* Turn client workflows and pain points into requirements, PRDs and roadmap recommendations with the Product Manager and engineering team.
* Help train, test, and refine AI-powered agents within our platform by defining the needs, partnering with engineering, helping to prepare knowledge content, validating responses, identifying gaps and more.

**Client enablement, training and documentation**

* Drive user and client adoption through owning all onboarding, demos and training within the platform.
* Create a consistent, efficient, and repeatable onboarding experience, including checklists, training materials, configuration guides, and handoff processes.
* Build and maintain internal documentation, implementation team playbooks, and operational workflows. Partner with product and engineering to also ensure the support team has all documentation and playbooks needed.
* Help migrate our product knowledge base into new support system Freshdesk, close gaps by creating missing documentation and materials needed, and train and refine AI support tools.
* Implement product tours within our platform for regular and recurring topics / questions.

**Client success and account management**

* Manage a portfolio of smaller technical accounts without a dedicated Account Manager.
* Host regular check-ins on performance, client satisfaction, platform usage and renewals, bringing expansion opportunities to the table with Sales.
* Serve as the client point of contact or internal subject matter expert for all technical account questions (non technical support related)

**What You Need**

* Approximately 5 years of experience in a mix across product operations, technical project management, technical implementation, platform operations, customer success, client management, and account management.
* Bachelors degree in relevant field
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn complex technologies, platforms and workflows.
* Direct experience in the creative, broadcast, streaming, or production industries are strongly preferred.
* Experience owning and executing custom client solution designs and implementations, client onboarding, technical projects, or platform rollouts.
* Comfortable working with technical concepts such as APIs, integrations, metadata, system configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Experience creating process documentation, training materials, knowledge bases, and standard operating procedures.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate across teams, and keep projects moving forward.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret usage and operational data and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment where processes and technologies are still being developed and improved.

### **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU**

At Orb Group, you’ll get an exciting challenge at an entrepreneurial and global company. With us, you get to work with market-leading brands and exciting customers who will challenge you, and you, them.

Our employee benefits include:

* 12 paid holidays per year
* 401k Retirement Plan (employer contributions vested immediately)
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Pet Insurance
* Flexible Vacation (Exempt Positions) or revise if for hourly
* Up to 14 days of paid sick leave
* Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave

**Compensation:** Salary Exempt position. $90,000 to $120,000 USD annual salary, with flexibility dependent on experience.

**Who We Are**

Meet Orb Group. We are an independent global specialist in production and content marketing from inception to delivery, powered by technology and fueled by creativity. We have multiple global offices and 100+ colleagues worldwide, but we work as one team. We’ve partnered with some of the world’s biggest and most innovative and recognizable brands, including Ikea, Dyson, Absolut, Netflix, CBS, Polestar, Lego and PBS. Just to name a few.

Orb Group provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
